canonical_example.text: Gané la lotería dos veces jugando con los mismos números.
canonical_example.translation: I won the lottery twice by playing the same set of numbers.

canonical_example.translation: I finally beat my dad in a game of chess.

canonical_example.text: ¡Gané! ¿Qué tal te caigo ahora?

canonical_example.translation: I'm moving to Europe next week. The thrill is killing me!
